lines.line: Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee;
as: our song shall rise to Thee;

lines.line: Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and seraphim falling down before Thee,
Holy, holy, holy! though the darkness hide Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see,
